highest_value_fixes.fix: Rebuild night values: reduce beige fill/haze, preserve darker wood/stone masses, motivate warm local pools at candles/lanterns, add cooler window/exit influence and integrate trainer contact. Repair visibly occluded windows and enclosure seams; determine causes from recaptures.
highest_value_fixes.reason: Largest common failure; night erases much of the dressing benefit.

highest_value_fixes.fix: Author human-scale use zones and structural hierarchy: develop rear reception/supply grouping, distinguish waiting/departure areas, break unbounded flooring with purposeful route/material grouping, and give upper masses convincing support and trim transitions. Check seat/door/trainer relationships while retaining clear movement space.
highest_value_fixes.reason: A proves dressing helps, but both remain large repeated shells.

highest_value_fixes.fix: Author substantial portal surrounds, biome emblems and shrine pedestal silhouettes in one stone/timber language. Replace thin labeled door/black-wall presentation and generic sloped lecterns with meaningful readable forms. New art means authored geometry/material/sign forms, not necessarily purchased assets.
highest_value_fixes.reason: Placement/tint cannot provide missing landmark and shrine identity at small size.

bar_a_world_fit_rationale: NO for both at the requested finished-world bar. Stone, timber, cream plaster, teal banners and blue adventurer are compatible ingredients; A is more welcoming through useful dressing. Neither achieves the keyart's authored masses, inviting occupation, focal hierarchy and depth. Judged on palette/mood/composition/silhouette, not painted fidelity or missing outdoor vegetation.
bar_b_atmosphere_rationale: NO for both at shipping Palworld/Valheim presentation bar. Broad fantasy third-person RPG category is suggested, but repetitive surfaces, weak structure, generic destinations, night bleaching and isolated character lighting lack the reference finish. A is better staged, not commercially resolved. No performance inference.
verdict: A is consistently preferable for occupation/composition, especially forward day and shrine day views. Neither passes the isolated Hall architecture defect. Human doors and A benches provide plausible local scale, but oversized bare spans, exterior-facade-like upper repetition, generic thresholds and weak grounding prevent convincing integration. Trainer silhouette and blue/brown color blocks read well; night disconnects it from the room. Rear fixed-idle captures do not prove facial quality, animation or traversal. Small-size readability is adequate for room/player, poor for biome/shrine identity. Isolated interior diagnostics only; no exterior/full-world/performance acceptance.
scoring_definition: Independent subjective 0-10 scores. Bar A: keyart palette, mood, composition, silhouette/world appeal. Bar B: shipping Palworld/Valheim stylized finish and light/atmosphere. Means over 26 separately inspected camera/preset pairs.
